text: Core courses Economics, Management, Marketing, Statistic, Chinese Tourism Geography, Hotel Management, Travel Agency Management, Tourism Resource Development and Planning, Tour Guide, Laws and Regulations of Tourism, Chinese History and Culture, Spoken English Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Objective This objective is to train students to be able to do management work in tourism administrative departments, travel agencies and hotels, or do planning, development and management works on tourism spots. In addition, students, after graduation, can work as tour guides in travel agencies, or teachers of tourism education in tourism colleges. Diploma Bachelor of Arts is granted Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation
